players.product: optical components for transceivers & CPO (FAU, lens assemblies, isolators)

quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical (company interview with General Manager Ou Yang at CIOE 2026): the company says its CPO-related optical connection products, after several years of development, have entered the mass-production delivery stage, and that ensuring quality, volume and delivery is its current operating priority.

TFC Optical (company interview with General Manager Ou Yang at CIOE 2026): passive components are the company's top priority and it will further expand production supply in Suzhou, Jiangxi and Thailand in line with customer demand; active products are made only as contract manufacturing, never under its own brand, with the active business focused on 800G-and-above high-speed optical device contract manufacturing and more products to be delivered from its Thailand plant in future.
TFC Optical: R&D investment was 6.89% of revenue in the first half of 2026; the company has R&D centers in Suzhou, Shenzhen and Japan covering passive and active optical devices.
